page.overview:
Who is Seron Varlin?

Seron Varlin trained as a swordmaster in the Ginaz School. He later lost his sight.

Varlin was approached by the Prisoner in Harko Village. He warned them to keep their distance, though he was past his prime he could still thrash them. They assured them that they meant him no harm and informed them that he scribed the word "regret" into the flesh of several individuals who attempted to toss him into the Deep desert to be eaten by a Sandworm. They asked him to train them in the ways of the Ginaz Swordmasters.
